integrity: The cardinality-ten optimum is prior work and is not claimed as new. The new census and orbit decomposition are derived from exact exhaustive tests and replayable standalone code; no independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The equality census is finite and computer-assisted. It classifies only maximum size-ten systems whose minimum Hamming distance is four, under the full binary Hamming-isometry group. An unindexed historical computation of the same subclass remains a residual originality risk. Older foundational literature was encountered without a verified public-release day, so no earlier day was invented.
title: Distance-four extremizers among optimal binary length-eight separating systems
